issue.title: Feature Question: Do you want to have an interactive option for command execution?
issue.body:
I am playing around with some CLI tools and from time to time I am annoyed by typing all the provided sub commands in the required chain and to add also the required parameters ... good for scripts, a bit to much copy/pasting for playing around.

I created for me some helper functions to use a fuzzy search approach to step from command to command, to make the experience in case more interactive. Since I am satisfied with the extension for myself, I wonder if you would like that I provide a PR to this code?

I see the number of open PRs and want with my question only avoid additional pressure :)

BR,
Eiko

comments.author: marckhouzam
comments.body:
I’m curious to see what user experience your tool provides. If it makes cobra better for everyone it will be welcomed. 

P.S. The project’s maintenance is admittedly very passive recently, but (speaking only for myself) if something new and existing comes along, I will try to squeeze extra time out of my daily schedule to get it merged.
